notes: FROZEN once live. Question order is part of the instrument (Pew split-sample order effects): the quiz and the audit share this order for every question tagged with both. Firmographics first, then dimensions in the order below. Satisfaction/pain questions are NOT front-loaded ahead of factual ones — doing so manufactures dissatisfaction by contrast and a sharp controller will notice.

questions.notes: Deliberately question 1: short, easy, unambiguous. First-question length is the single strongest completion predictor after open-ended count (Liu & Wronski 2018, beta=-0.016). Also the most load-bearing field in the whole instrument — every Charter of the French Language threshold keys off it (5-24 / 25+ / 100+).

stem.en: How many parts of the business depend on exactly one person?

stem.en: Your main system is unavailable for two days. Is there a plan?

stem.en: When someone needs to look something up — a spec, a past quote, a policy — where do they go?

label.en: Scattered files and old email threads
label.fr: Des fichiers éparpillés et de vieux fils de courriels

label.en: A shared drive, no real structure

questions.notes: Grounded in NIST AI RMF MAP-3 and the Microsoft CAF 'identify AI use cases' step. Deliberately about a NAMED task with a MEASURED current cost, because that is the condition under which an AI pilot is scopeable at all.

label.fr: Nous avons parlé d'une en particulier

questions.notes: Separated from data_reporting on purpose. Without this split, a client with a pretty dashboard and no operating review scores the same as one that runs a weekly meeting off its numbers — the most common misdiagnosis in this category. CMMI makes measurement one of only two practice areas that reach level 5.

label.fr: Nous révisons une courte liste d'indicateurs d'exploitation à intervalles fixes

label.fr: Ces indicateurs ont des cibles et des responsables, et nous agissons sur les écarts

stem.en: How many operating numbers — not financial statements — does leadership look at on a fixed cadence?
stem.fr: Combien d'indicateurs d'exploitation — pas des états financiers — la direction consulte-t-elle à intervalles fixes?

questions.notes: Bands are deliberately not monotonic. More than about twenty-five is a dashboard nobody reads, which scores level 3, not level 5.

stem.en: Do those numbers have a target and a named owner?
stem.fr: Ces indicateurs ont-ils une cible et un responsable nommé?

label.fr: Des cibles, dans la tête de quelqu'un

stem.en: If you did a project like this, who inside the business would own the outcome?
stem.fr: Si vous réalisiez un projet comme celui-ci, qui, dans l'entreprise, serait responsable du résultat?

questions.notes: The most universally present dimension in every ERP-readiness instrument surveyed and the strongest single predictor of ERP failure. It also protects NBT commercially: it is the dimension that says whether to take the engagement.

label.en: We haven't identified anyone

label.en: The owner, on top of everything else they do

label.fr: Un parrain et un responsable interne, avec une rencontre de pilotage régulière

label.en: Nothing out of the ordinary

stem.en: Who is named as the person in charge of personal information in your business?
stem.fr: Qui est désigné comme responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels dans votre entreprise?

help.fr: Au Québec, c'est une obligation légale depuis septembre 2022, incluant la publication de ses coordonnées.

label.en: Nobody is named
